problem: Which of the following is equivalent to  $\operatorname{tanh}⁡(3\operatorname{ln}⁡y)?$
worked_solution:
The definition of $\operatorname{tanh}⁡x$ is 
        

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{tanh}⁡x & =\frac{{e}^{x}-{e}^{-x}}{{e}^{x}+{e}^{-x}} \\  & =\frac{{e}^{2x}-1}{{e}^{2x}+1} \\  & =\frac{1-{e}^{-2x}}{1+{e}^{-2x}}.\end{aligned}
$$

Using the second definition, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{tanh}⁡(3\operatorname{ln}⁡y) & =\frac{{e}^{2(3\operatorname{ln}⁡y)}-1}{{e}^{2(3\operatorname{ln}⁡y)}+1} \\  & =\frac{{e}^{6\operatorname{ln}⁡y}-1}{{e}^{6\operatorname{ln}⁡y}+1} \\  & =\frac{{e}^{\operatorname{ln}⁡{y}^{6}}-1}{{e}^{\operatorname{ln}⁡{y}^{6}}+1} \\  & =\frac{{y}^{6}-1}{{y}^{6}+1}.\end{aligned}
$$
